knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Overview
This analysis investigates the difference in total GBA1 levels within Bxb1 integrated single GBA1 variant expressing HEK293T landing pad cell lines.

Analysis included shown in supplementary figure 12

```{r packages}
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)
library(multcomp)
```

# Load raw data
Load total GBA1 immunoblotting analysis

```{r load-data}
SingleVariant_Input <- readxl::read_excel("Single Variant_Total GBA_Input.xlsx")
```

# Preparing Data
```{r preparing data}
ControlVariant <- c("Unmodified Cells", "KO", "WT")
StartCodon_Variant <- c("M1A", "M21A")
WorseThanStopCodon_Variant <- c("D166G", "Y352K")
PathogenicVariant <- c("R159W", "G241R", "V414L", "V433L", "D448H", "L483P", "R502C")
LikelyPathogenicVariant <- c("S310G", "N409S", "W417G", "V437I", "V499L")
Benign <- "E365K"
VUS <- c("R83C", "T408M", "N231K", "R324H", "P358L", "V391L", "A495P")

Input_annotated <- SingleVariant_Input %>%
  dplyr::select(Test, Cell_Line, Fold_Change) %>%
  mutate(MAVE_grouping = case_when(
    Cell_Line %in% ControlVariant ~ "Control",
    Cell_Line %in% PathogenicVariant ~ "Pathogenic",
    Cell_Line %in% LikelyPathogenicVariant ~ "Likely Pathogenic",
    Cell_Line %in% Benign ~ "Benign",
    Cell_Line %in% VUS ~ "VUS",
    Cell_Line %in% StartCodon_Variant ~ "Start Codon",
    Cell_Line %in% WorseThanStopCodon_Variant ~ "Worse than Stop Codon",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_   
  )) %>%
  mutate(Cell_Line = factor(Cell_Line, levels = c("Unmodified Cells", "KO", "WT",
                                                  "R159W", "G241R", "V414L", "V433L", "D448H", "L483P", "R502C",
                                                  "S310G", "N409S", "W417G", "V437I", "V499L",
                                                  "E365K",
                                                  "R83C", "N231K", "R324H", "P358L", "V391L", "T408M", "A495P",
                                                  " ",
                                                  "M1A", "M21A",
                                                  "D166G", "Y352K")))  %>%
  mutate(MAVE_grouping = factor(MAVE_grouping, levels = c("Control", "Pathogenic",
                                                          "Likely Pathogenic", 
                                                          "Benign",
                                                          "VUS",
                                                          "Start Codon",
                                                          "Worse than Stop Codon"))) 

```

# Perform statistical analysis 
```{r stats analysis}

Input_annotated$Cell_Line <- relevel(Input_annotated$Cell_Line, ref = "WT")

### Stats
model <- aov(Fold_Change ~ Cell_Line, data = Input_annotated)

glht_model <- glht(
  model,
  linfct = mcp(Cell_Line = "Dunnett")
)

dunnett <- summary(glht_model)

estimates <- dunnett$test$coefficients
pvals <- dunnett$test$pvalues
tstats <- dunnett$test$tstat
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(glht_model)))

Dunnett_table <- data.frame(
  comparison = names(estimates),
  estimate = estimates,
  std_error = se,
  t_stat = tstats,
  p_value = pvals
)


Dunnett_table$significance <- cut(Dunnett_table$p_value,
                                  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
                                  labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))

Stats <- Dunnett_table %>%
  mutate(Variant = sub(" - WT$", "", comparison))
```

# Plotting Single Variant GCase Assay Data
```{r plotting}

sig_positions <- Input_annotated %>%
  group_by(Cell_Line) %>%
  summarise(
    y_pos = max(Fold_Change, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge with Dunnett significance table
sig_labels <- Stats %>%
  dplyr::select(Variant, significance) %>%
  rename(Cell_Line = Variant) %>%
  left_join(sig_positions, by = "Cell_Line")


Selection_Colours <- c("Control" = "white", 
                       "Pathogenic" = "#C62828",
                       "Likely Pathogenic" = "#F9A825",
                       "Benign" = "#1565C0",
                       "VUS" = "#7E57C2",
                       "Start Codon" = "grey",
                       "Worse than Stop Codon" = "black")


# Plotting Fold Change for each variant
TotalGBA_plot <- Input_annotated %>%
  filter(!Cell_Line %in% "Unmodified Cells") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Cell_Line, y = Fold_Change)) +
  
  # individual points (Test 1 & Test 2)
  geom_jitter(
    color = "black",
    width = 0.1,
    height = 0,
    size = 2,
    shape = 16,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # mean bar with SE error bars
  stat_summary(aes(fill = MAVE_grouping),
               fun = mean, 
               geom = "col", 
               width = 0.7, 
               color = "black",  
               linewidth = 0.25 , alpha = 0.2) +
  # SE error bars
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.7,    
    color = "black",  
    linewidth = 0.1  
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Selection_Colours,
                    name = NULL) +
  

  # horizontal line at y = 1
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, 
             color = "darkgreen", 
             alpha = 1, 
             linewidth = 0.25,    
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  # y-axis limits
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.5),
    breaks = seq(0, 1.5, by = 0.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = "GBA1 Variant",
    y = "Total GBA1"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # backgrounds
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.15),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    # grid lines 
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.15),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.15),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 55, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )


print(TotalGBA_plot)

ggsave("Total GBA plot.pdf", 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       plot = TotalGBA_plot, 
       width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 600)

```
